name: Gravity Shooter
summary:
Control the ball with gravity, destroy approaching enemies, and survive the onslaught!
Gravity Shooter is a sci-fi shooter that incorporates Bullet Heaven elements.

- A fresh shooter experience with gravity manipulation! -
Unlike typical shooting games, your main weapon is a "ball".
Operate the ball using the gravity generation device, "Gravity Shield".
Freely manipulate this ball to destroy enemies, collect items, and obtain further weapons and skills!

- Fight using a wide variety of weapons and skills! -
Level up by acquiring items or obtain equipment capsules to gain powerful weapons and skills.
Combine a wide variety of weapons and skills to survive the ever-intensifying enemy onslaught!

- Conquer diverse stages and enemies! -
Unique stages are available in this game, each with its own characteristic enemies and bosses.
Conquer all stages and defeat the formidable enemies you have yet to see!
